BOOKKEEPING PROPOSAL

P R O P O S E D  B Y

REGENT PARK FILM FESTIVAL

6  J U N E ,  2 0 2 5

SCOPE & SERVICES

Core Bookkeeping & Reconciliations
Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records in QBO
Record all income transactions (grants, sponsorships, donations, sales, etc.)
Enter and categorize all expenses with proper coding and documentation
Categorize restricted vs. unrestricted funds
Record and reconcile all AP/AR transactions
Monthly bank and credit card reconciliations
Weekly bookkeeping cadence during festival season (Sept–Nov)
Monthly bookkeeping cadence during off-season (Dec - Aug)

Payroll Administration & Compliance
Bi-weekly payroll processing for full-time salaried staff and seasonal employees (via QBO Payroll)
Manage seasonal payroll and/or Canada Summer Jobs for contract staff
Ensure accurate source deductions, CPP/EI remittances, CRA compliance
Prepare and issue T4, T4A, and ROE forms; maintain payroll records

Financial Reporting & Governance
Monthly financial statements: P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, AR/AP
Virtual check-in to review financials
Custom funder and board reporting as needed

Compliance, Year-End & Audit Support
Prepare and file HST returns, including PSB rebate
Ensure compliance with CRA regulations for registered charities
Prepare annual T3010 Registered Charity Information Return
Preparation of financial reports for the auditor
Coordination with the tax preparer & facilitation of any additional requests
Year-end meeting to review financial results and discuss the upcoming year

*NEW* Process & Technology Improvements
Implement automated bill payment system via Plooto
Bookkeepers set up payments, routed to ED for quick approval via email
Link payment schedule with bookkeeping cadence for ease and efficiency
Use proprietary Google Forms for receipt and receivables documentation
Reduce manual payment processing and streamline internal workflows

ONE-TIME SETUP & COSTS

Plooto Setup:
Full setup and integration of Plooto with QBO and RPFF’s bank
Creation of customized approval workflows reflecting RPFF’s internal controls and signing authorities
Staff onboarding and training
Support during the initial 1–2 cycles to ensure smooth transition

Proprietary RPFF Google Forms for Expenses & Revenue:
Setup custom forms based on RPFF account lines & classes
Staff training / video to ensure consistent submissions
Setup Fees:  $0 $2500 + HST

MONTHLY FEES

Monthly Fees: $1000/month + HST
✔  Includes all items listed under “Scope & Services”
✔ Also includes unlimited email interactions, monthly or biweekly check-ins and any other virtual meetings, as per client need

The following charges are not included in the monthly fee:
Software subscriptions such as QBO and Plooto
Bookkeeping backlog: Any prior period bookkeeping clean-up or catch-up work will be quoted separately based on the volume and complexity

WHY US?

Sympl Solutions is committed to ensuring a high standard of financial clarity and timely support. We bring:
A responsive, detail-oriented team
Experience with arts and non-profit organizations across Canada
Streamlined tech integration and clear process flows
Decade-long expertise in nonprofit finance
BIPOC-led leadership with lived experiences in community arts

We value thoughtful system design, clarity in reporting, and building long-term trusted partnerships.

Any new requirements or adjustments can be discussed and integrated as needed. We work with transparency, flexibility, and a commitment to helping our partners thrive.
